roles.name: lcars-ripple-color
roles.description: Button press ripple (issue #149). Themes can override the wash color and either opacity. Color defaults to the mode-aware contrast token (black in light mode, white in dark); pressed opacity is ~3x HA's 0.12 default so a tap is unmistakable on any button color.
